input_zh: 本次同日 Production Recovery 使用最新 main 控制面，包括 Scheduler V3.0、Worker Control v1.3.0、SHA-256 为 f782b39f31f4a3f94d0a35c2041f05d99f42f8a537ddfebcb235a3985aafba67 的 Generated Production Prompt v2.8.0、全部 Production Required Source、显式 runtime-process-kick/v2 terminal-recovery 授权、Recovery Wake Receipt research/runtime/wakes/2026/08/2026-08-15/production-155939.json、重新开启的 Production Execution Epoch、已持久化的 Worker Claimed 提交 84919df9a27652c33059a4e0f4ab9fc72bace23b，以及三份同日已完成 Research Object：Q-20260815-01、Q-20260815-02、Q-20260815-03。
workResult: Recovery admission and ordered reconciliation succeeded. The current Production Prompt had already been strengthened with premium editorial-cover art direction: one dominant physical metaphor, foreground/midground/background depth, material language, cinematic key and rim light, volumetric atmosphere, controlled palette and magazine-cover composition. After fresh Worker Claim, Q-20260815-01 was translated into a physical scene separating preserved history/protocol state from a distinct human authorization act. Three positive-only scene variants were attempted. Despite those article-only instructions, each generated image was a high-density Runtime recovery dashboard/report, including fabricated Runtime milestones, gate tables and batch summaries. The repeated failure therefore did not come from insufficient visual richness in the article brief; it came from the image-generation path continuing to absorb the surrounding Runtime automation context. The mandatory Cover Gate correctly rejected every attempt and stopped the batch.
workResult_zh: Recovery Admission 与有序 Reconciliation 均成功。当前 Production Prompt 已强化为正式高级题图艺术指导：单一主视觉隐喻、前中后景纵深、材质语言、电影级主光与轮廓光、体积氛围、克制配色和杂志封面构图。Fresh Worker Claim 之后，Q-20260815-01 被转换为“保存的 History / Protocol State 与独立 Human Authorization 行为分离”的物理场景，并按规则连续尝试 3 个纯正向场景版本。尽管给出的都是文章级视觉描述，每次生成结果仍然是高信息密度 Runtime Recovery Dashboard / 报告，并自动带入虚构的 Runtime 时间线、Gate 表格和 Batch 摘要。因此本轮失败不再是题图 Brief 过于简单，而是图像生成路径持续吸收外围 Runtime Automation 上下文。强制 Cover Gate 正确拒绝了全部尝试，并停止了批次。
output: A governed Blocked Production result only. Zero accepted raster covers, zero Publication Candidates, zero public-page changes, and Publication remains ineligible.

next: Do not enter Publication. The durable fix must change the image-generation execution boundary, not merely enrich the art-direction wording again. Article cover generation needs an isolated image-generation context whose effective conversation contains only one Article Cover Brief / sanitized visual scene and no Runtime recovery/control-plane narrative. Until that isolation exists, future Production runs should fail closed at Cover Gate rather than repeatedly rewriting the same prompt or admitting dashboard-like imagery.
next_zh: 不得进入 Publication。真正需要修复的是图像生成的执行边界，而不是继续增加艺术指导词。Article Cover Generation 需要独立的图像生成上下文，使图像模型的有效上下文只包含单篇 Article Cover Brief / sanitized visual scene，不包含 Runtime Recovery 或控制面叙事。在实现这种隔离之前，后续 Production 应继续在 Cover Gate Fail-closed，而不是反复改写同类 Prompt 或接纳 Dashboard 风格图像。
